School Administration Protocol

Student Batch Upload Architecture & Guide

Affiliated institutions can enroll full candidate trainee batches at once using our standardized Excel format. The system verifies records automatically before saving to database.

How the Batch Enrollment System Works

Step 1

Download Format

Download the official AOPSTSMA pre-formatted Excel / CSV template with predefined column headers.

Step 2

Fill Student Rolls

Enter student names, roll numbers, DOB, course (D.El.Ed / B.Ed) without altering the column names.

Step 3

Upload & Verify

Upload file. The system checks duplicates and generates the student registration database and demands.

All Orissa Secondary Training Schools Association

All Orissa Private Secondary Training Schools Management Association (AOPSTSMA). The apex body representing recognized D.El.Ed & B.Ed secondary training institutions across 30 districts of Odisha since 1980.

Registered under Societies Registration Act XXI of 1860 · Regd. No. 1422/80
